_doc: Generated by tools/mapgen/extract (see its README); do not edit. Derived numbers only, read from the r6calls Oregon SVG (floor rasters, overlay vectors, icons) and checked against the official blueprint: no image data. Units: u (research/oregon/layout_notes.md §1) in each floor image's own frame (2F is about 2.4% larger than 1F; cross_floor has the fits). walls[].rect / openings[].rect = [x0, y0, x1, y1]; k = H (runs along x) or V (along y); c = centre line; t = drawn thickness. The authoring files data/maps/oregon/walls_<floor>.json were seeded from this file; the drift test compares them.

cross_floor.finding: The per-floor rasters do not share one frame: they are perspective renders (the official blueprints have the same per-floor scale). Walls that stack 1F->2F fit u_2F = a*u_1F + b with a = 1.0233 (x) / 1.0261 (y), rms 0.29/0.31 u over 22/18 wall pairs; an isotropic 1.0247 about (-1, 107.7) u fits almost as well. Map 2F into the 1F frame before stacking.

to_1F.B: UNVERIFIED: stairwell walls (Tower, Laundry/Armory stairs) stack best with u_1F = s*(u_B - p) + p, s = 1.020-1.028, p = (-1, 107.7), i.e. the same perspective step as 1F->2F; r6calls' copied hatch rects favour identity. Needs Ulo.
to_1F.3F: UNVERIFIED: only the tower walls overlap; assuming the catwalk walls stand on the 2F tower walls, u_3F = 1.0755*x_2F - 9.04 / 1.079*y_2F - 7.32 (not the 1.025 perspective step). Needs Ulo.
